description: Restart Petclinic Tomcat after a Secrets Manager AWSCURRENT change, then verify read and write database connectivity without printing credentials.

VersionId.description: Expected current Secrets Manager version ID

runCommand:
set -euo pipefail
EXPECTED="${SSM_VersionId}"
SECRET_ARN='arn:aws:secretsmanager:ap-northeast-2:723165663216:secret:RDS-Secret-key-SwRTa1'
ACTUAL=$(/usr/bin/aws secretsmanager get-secret-value --region ap-northeast-2 --secret-id "$SECRET_ARN" --query VersionId --output text)
if [ "$ACTUAL" != "$EXPECTED" ]; then echo 'Requested secret version is no longer AWSCURRENT'; exit 42; fi
MARKER=/var/lib/petclinic-bootstrap/last-applied-secret-version
mkdir -p /var/lib/petclinic-bootstrap
exec 9>/run/lock/petclinic-secret-refresh.lock
flock -x 9
TMP=$(mktemp -d /run/petclinic-secret-refresh.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
cat > "$TMP/DbProbe.java" <<'JAVA'
import java.io.*;import java.sql.*;import java.util.*;
public class DbProbe {
 public static void main(String[] a) throws Exception {
  Properties p=new Properties();try(InputStream in=new FileInputStream("/run/petclinic/data-access.properties")){p.load(in);}
  Class.forName("com.mysql.cj.jdbc.Driver");String user=p.getProperty("jdbc.username"),pass=p.getProperty("jdbc.password");
  for(String key:new String[]{"jdbc.url","jdbc.read.url"}){String url=p.getProperty(key);if(url==null||user==null||pass==null)throw new Exception("required datasource property missing");try(Connection c=DriverManager.getConnection(url,user,pass);Statement s=c.createStatement();ResultSet r=s.executeQuery("SELECT 1")){if(!r.next()||r.getInt(1)!=1)throw new Exception("database probe returned unexpected result");System.out.println(key+" AUTH_OK");}catch(SQLException e){System.out.println(key+" AUTH_FAIL code="+e.getErrorCode()+" state="+e.getSQLState());System.exit(1);}}
 }
}
JAVA
LIB=/opt/tomcat/webapps/petclinic/WEB-INF/lib/*
/usr/bin/javac -cp "$LIB" -d "$TMP" "$TMP/DbProbe.java"
probe(){ CODE=$(/usr/bin/curl --noproxy '*' --silent --output /dev/null --write-out '%{http_code}' --max-time 8 http://127.0.0.1:8080/petclinic/vets || true); [ "$CODE" = 200 ] && /usr/bin/java -cp "$TMP:$LIB" DbProbe; }
if [ -r "$MARKER" ] && [ "$(cat "$MARKER")" = "$EXPECTED" ] && systemctl is-active --quiet tomcat && probe; then echo 'This secret version was already applied and verified'; exit 0; fi
/usr/bin/timeout 90 /usr/bin/systemctl restart tomcat
OK=0
for i in $(seq 1 90); do if systemctl is-active --quiet tomcat && probe; then OK=1; break; fi; sleep 2; done
if [ "$OK" != 1 ]; then echo 'Tomcat or database verification did not become healthy within 180 seconds'; exit 1; fi
printf '%s\n' "$EXPECTED" > "$TMP/applied-version"
chmod 0600 "$TMP/applied-version"
chown root:root "$TMP/applied-version"
/usr/bin/install -o root -g root -m 0600 "$TMP/applied-version" "$MARKER.tmp"
/usr/bin/mv -f "$MARKER.tmp" "$MARKER"
echo 'Tomcat, primary database, and read-replica database checks succeeded'
